title: 第7章 这一下床翻脸比翻书还快第8章 师尊你这是在玩火
slug: 救了元婴宗主夫人醒后她急了
content_zh:
;;
这一刻，密室外的天象也随之变幻。
原本晴朗的天穹卷起滚滚乌云，沉闷的雷声在天剑宗的峰顶炸响。
狂风呼啸着刮过山门，无数苍翠的树梢在风中疯狂摇曳，发出呜呜的哀鸣。
密室内，柳师师只觉得肺里的空气正被陆长生一点点抽干。
她的脑子彻底成了一团浆糊。
她原本是元婴大能。
可此刻，她居然觉得自己像一尾被拎出水面的鱼。
氧气在急速流失。肺腑里像塞了团湿棉花，闷得她太阳穴突突直跳，眼前的画面都开始发花。
偏偏那个只有炼气期修为的混蛋，手掌还稳稳扣着她的后脑勺，拇指不轻不重地摩挲着她耳后那一小块皮肤，力道温吞得要命，却叫她整条脊背都酥了半边。
但事实就是——她快无法呼吸了。
柳师师动用了平生最后吃奶的力气，双掌抵上陆长生的胸膛，拼了命地往外推。
“唔——！”
陆长生被她推得踉跄退了两步，抬手不紧不慢地抹了下嘴角，表情倒是坦然得很，甚至还微微扬了扬下巴。
柳师师撑着膝盖，弯腰大口大口喘气，耳根子红得能滴血，声音断断续续：
“你……你等会儿……”
“让我……换个气……”
她喘得上气不接下气，一只手捂着胸口，像是刚从深渊里爬出来的溺水之人。
“差点……被你憋死了你知不知道？”
陆长生靠在石壁上，手臂环胸，歪头看着她。

灯火跳动间，他眼底漾着一层浅淡的笑意，那笑意不深，却怎么看都带着几分欠揍的味道。
“师尊。”
他开口，嗓音还带着方才的低哑。
“你不会用鼻子呼吸吗？”
柳师师喘气的动作顿了一拍。
她慢慢抬起头，一双水雾弥漫的眼睛瞪着他，嘴唇微微张开。
“……啊？”
陆长生的拇指蹭了蹭自己的鼻尖，神色理所当然：“鼻子。呼吸。嘴不方便的时候，用鼻子啊。”
他说得平平淡淡，像是在教一个蒙童识字，语气甚至还带着几分耐心。
柳师师整个人都愣住了。
半晌，她的脸从耳根红到了脖颈，那片红色沿着皮肤蔓延的速度比灵力运转还快，声音小得像蚊子哼哼：
“我……那个……一时忘记了。”
她下意识地咬了下唇，视线飘到密室角落的一盏长明灯上，死活不肯看他。
“我又没试过，我怎么知道。”
说完这句话，她恨不得给自己一巴掌。
堂堂元婴大能，活了快一百岁了，亲个嘴，居然忘了用鼻子呼吸，差点被自己的徒弟憋死在密室里。
这要是传出去，她柳师师的脸往哪儿搁？
陆长生轻轻笑了一声。
“天啊师尊，你活了几十年，难道连最基本的亲法都不会吗？”他摇了摇头，眼底笑意更浓了几分，“真悲催。过来。”
他伸出手。

柳师师没动。
“干什么？”
“我教你。”
他说这两个字的时候，密室外又一道惊雷炸响。灵石阵纹上的光华明灭交替，将他半边脸映得忽明忽暗。亮的那半张脸笑得坦荡，暗的那半张脸藏着什么东西，看不真切。
柳师师的手指攥紧了袖口里的布料，指节收了又松，松了又收，反反复复，像是在做什么了不得的抉择。

At this moment, the sky outside the secret room also changed.
Rolling dark clouds rolled up in the originally sunny sky, and dull thunder exploded on the peak of Tianjian Sect.
The strong wind howled past the mountain gate, and countless green treetops swayed crazily in the wind, making whining sounds.
In the secret room, Master Liu felt that the air in his lungs was being drained bit by bit by Lu Changsheng.
Her brain was completely turned into mush.
She was originally a powerful Nascent Soul.
But at this moment, she actually felt like a fish being lifted out of the water.
Oxygen is being lost rapidly. It felt like there was a ball of wet cotton stuffed in her heart, which made her temples throb and the scene in front of her began to blur.
But that bastard, who was only in the Qi Refining stage, still held the back of her head firmly with his palm, and gently rubbed the small piece of skin behind her ear with his thumb. The force was so warm that it made half of her back go numb.
But the fact is - she can't breathe.
Liu Shishi used the last strength he had in his life to put his palms on Lu Changsheng's chest and pushed it out as hard as he could.
"Uh-!"
Lu Changsheng staggered back two steps after being pushed by her. He raised his hand and wiped the corners of his mouth slowly. His expression was very calm, and he even raised his chin slightly.
Liu Shishi propped up his knees, bent over and gasped for air, his ears were so red that they could bleed, and his voice was intermittent:
"You...you wait a moment..."
"Let me... take a breather..."
She was out of breath, covering her chest with one hand, like a drowning person who had just climbed out of the abyss.
"I almost...suffocated you to death, do you know that?"
Lu Changsheng leaned against the stone wall, crossed his arms across his chest, and tilted his head to look at her.
灯火跳动间，他眼底漾着一层浅淡的笑意，那笑意不深，却怎么看都带着几分欠揍的味道。
"Master."
He spoke, his voice still husky as before.
"Don't you know how to breathe through your nose?"
Liu Shishi's breathing paused for a moment.
She slowly raised her head, staring at him with a pair of misty eyes, her lips slightly parted.
"...Huh?"
Lu Changsheng rubbed the tip of his nose with his thumb and said with a matter-of-fact expression: "Nose. Breathe. When your mouth is inconvenient, use your nose."
He spoke calmly, as if he was teaching a young boy how to read, and his tone was even a little patient.
Liu Shishi was stunned.
After a while, her face turned red from the roots of her ears to her neck. The red color spread along her skin faster than the movement of her spiritual energy. Her voice was as low as a mosquito's hum:
"I... that... forgot about it for a moment."
She bit her lower lip subconsciously, her eyes drifting to a bright light in the corner of the secret room, refusing to look at him.
"I haven't tried it, how do I know?"
After saying this, she wanted to slap herself.
The mighty Nascent Soul, who has lived for almost a hundred years, even kissed him on the mouth and forgot to breathe through his nose. He was almost suffocated to death in the secret room by his disciple.
If this spreads out, where will her Master Liu's face be?
Lu Changsheng laughed softly.
"Oh my God, Master, you have lived for decades, don't you even know how to practice the most basic pro-French teachings?" He shook his head, and the smile in his eyes became a little thicker, "It's so sad. Come here."
He held out his hand.
Master Liu didn't move.
"What?"
"I'll teach you."
When he said these two words, another thunder exploded outside the secret room. The light on the spirit stone pattern alternated between on and off, making half of his face flicker. The bright half of the face smiles openly, but the dark half of the face hides something, which is hard to see clearly.
Liu Shishi's fingers clenched the fabric in the cuffs tightly, tightening and loosening his knuckles, loosening and tightening again, over and over again, as if he was making a huge decision.
